headline: Get Helmwhelp
title: How to Get Helmwhelp | Wild Only in Russet Highlands | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Helmwhelp is a Wind Break fighter that you can catch in the wild, but only in Russet Highlands, at levels in the high forties. It is the middle form of the Jawling line, so you can also evolve a Jawling at level thirty eight. From Helmwhelp you can reach Helgon or Infergon at level forty eight. It stands one point six meters tall. Have you found a Helmwhelp yet? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Helmwhelp is a Wind Break fighter found wild in Russet Highlands. Jawling evolves into it at level 38, and it becomes Helgon or Infergon at level 48.
